message.content: Which of our stateful object classes have instances that currently hold stored data?

content.text:
I can't tell you which classes have instances holding stored data, because these tools are dry runs and returned no account data. I built the two requests that would answer it, and neither was sent:

1. `GET /accounts/demo/workers/durable_objects/namespaces?per_page=100` lists the Durable Object namespaces. Each namespace is one class, and the response gives its `class` and `id`.
2. `GET /accounts/demo/workers/durable_objects/namespaces/demo-namespace/objects?limit=1000` lists the objects in one namespace. Each object in the response has a `hasStoredData` flag.

To get the answer, run the second request once for each namespace ID that the first one returns. Use the `cursor` to page through any namespace with more than 1000 objects. A class counts if at least one of its objects has `hasStoredData: true`.

I loaded the durable-objects skill and built the list-namespaces and list-objects requests. I used `demo-namespace` as a placeholder ID because the dry run returned no real namespace IDs, so I have no result to report.
